moduleDoc:
Multi-Currency Dynamic FX Hedging Pool (Issue #221).

Protects international real estate investors receiving dividends in volatile currencies
by auto-executing FX forward hedges using DEX liquidity pools:
- Ingests FX rate oracle feeds (e.g., EUR/USD, GBP/USD, JPY/USD).
- Calculates required FX forward hedge ratios based on projected annual dividend yields.
- Executes automated rebalancing swaps when currency fluctuations exceed variance limits.

methods.name: initialize
methods.doc: Initialize the FX hedging pool with an admin and an authorized oracle address.

methods.name: set_oracle
methods.doc: Set or update the authorized oracle feed provider.

methods.name: ingest_oracle_rate
methods.doc: Ingest FX rate oracle feeds (e.g., EUR/USD, GBP/USD, JPY/USD). Rates scaled by 10,000 (e.g. 10850 = 1.0850).

methods.name: setup_hedge
methods.doc: Register or configure a currency forward hedge for an international real estate asset. Calculates the initial required forward hedge ratio based on projected annual dividend yield.

methods.name: calculate_hedge_ratio
methods.doc: Calculate required FX forward hedge ratio (in basis points) based on projected annual dividend yields. Model: Higher dividend yields require scaled coverage to insulate cashflow against downside FX swings. - Yield <= 5% (500 bps) -> 80% coverage (8000 bps) - Yield between 5% and 10% -> 90% coverage (9000 bps) - Yield > 10% -> 100% coverage (10000 bps)

methods.name: execute_rebalance
methods.doc: Execute automated rebalancing swaps when currency fluctuations exceed variance limits. Returns the rebalanced swap amount and new hedged position.

methods.name: get_hedge_position
methods.doc: Read hedge position for a given pair.
